definitions.explanation: An arrangement to have something at a particular time.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}が{必要|ひつよう}ですか。
レストランの{予約|よやく}をした。
{人気|にんき}のレストランなので、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{前|まえ}に{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: It's a popular restaurant, so I made a reservation a week in advance.

notes:
{予約|よやく} means reservation, booking, or appointment. As a verbal noun, it forms {予約|よやく}する (to reserve/book).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予約|よやく}する: to make a reservation
- {予約|よやく}を{取|と}る: to make a reservation
- {予約|よやく}を{入|い}れる: to book, make an appointment
- {予約|よやく}を{取|と}り{消|け}す: to cancel a reservation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レストランの{予約|よやく}: restaurant reservation
- ホテルの{予約|よやく}: hotel booking
- {病院|びょういん}の{予約|よやく}: doctor's appointment
- {予約|よやく}{済|ず}み: already reserved

RELATED:
- {予約|よやく}{席|せき}: reserved seat
- {予約|よやく}{制|せい}: reservation required
- {要|よう}{予約|よやく}: reservation necessary
